text:
[issue by ChaldS-mods]
Environment:

Minecraft version: 1.21.1
Create version: 0.6.10
Mod loader: NeoForge 21.1.233

Description:
When attempting to retrieve a packaged Minecart Contraption item from a Packager, the client immediately disconnects/crashes with a networking error along the lines of "Internal error occurred" / "Internal Exception: java.lang.RuntimeException".

Steps to Reproduce:

Assemble a minecart contraption and package it into an item using a Create Packager.
Attempt to retrieve/unpack that item from the Packager (e.g. via the box output / redistribution).
Client disconnects with the error described above.

Expected behavior:
The packaged minecart contraption item should be retrieved normally without disconnecting the client.

Actual behavior:
Client is kicked/crashes with a generic internal network error.

Additional context:
No crash report/log was saved at the time, so I can't attach a stack trace. Happy to reproduce and gather logs if that would help — let me know what info would be useful.

This may be related to the contraption's NBT data exceeding the packet size limit when it's serialized into the packaged item, causing the network stack to reject/fail to decode the packet.
